authorization: User autonomous expanded goal and standing auto-approval; log functional proxies for later review.
basis: Positive1kgdrywood references, factor+1 for matching dry-kg fuel inputs. No MJ-to-kg conversion or LHV rescaling.
limitations: Native forest-road chips proxy purpose-grown woody/energy-crop supply; land use, cultivation, species, harvest and allocation differ. Clean sawmill chips proxy forest residues; collection/chipping, origin, coproduct allocation and delivery differ. Complete native inventories and their existing carbon accounting are retained; no invented biogenic uptake, recovery credit or drying burden.

All selected supplies reference one kilogram of dry wood; preserve fuel dry mass without converting the separate gross-energy residue process to kg. IAM technology fractions use a common woody-fuel basis; no density, moisture or calorific multiplier is inferred. Geographic portfolios and vintage remain screening proxies with unquantified score effects.

pellet_decision.scope: Retain complete native pellet factory and original signed dry-kg feedstock coefficients; replace only native chip/shavings/sawdust supply links with the regional IAM dry-wood mix. Retain all binder, electricity/heat, infrastructure, freight, packaging, wastes, production and direct emissions. Do not replace the complete pellet service with raw chips.
pellet_decision.limitations: Native forest/sawmill chips proxy the original dry-kg shavings and sawdust feedstocks only inside pellet manufacture. Particle size, moisture, milling/drying/pressing performance, collection, origin and coproduct allocation differ. All original factory process coefficients remain; no guessed grinding, drying, yield, calorific or density multiplier is added. Upstream feedstock burdens change and score effects are unquantified; no equivalence is claimed.
